description: vpc/v1 BREAKING attempt: adds a REQUIRED `region` to v1. Existing v1 specs (which omit region) would become invalid, so the publish linter classifies this BREAKING and REJECTS it with HTTP 409 — the message says to ship a new kind_version (that's exactly vpc-v2.kind.json). There is NO override; a breaking change must become a new kind_version. Applying this must FAIL 409; that failure is the demo.

region.description: REQUIRED region — a BREAKING addition to v1.
